purpose: Human-facing durable project selector for fresh Prometeo chats. Project numbers are presentation aliases only; durable identity is project_id.

selection_law.fresh_chat_prometeo: If no project is already bound and there is no recoverable materially-unsatisfied local intent, show this project's menu instead of guessing a workstream.
selection_law.numeric_selection: A bare menu number resolves through menu_order to a durable project_id, then loads that project's recovery pointers and binds the current disposable chat instance to it.
selection_law.number_is_not_identity: Menu numbers may change. Never persist a number as project identity; persist project_id.
selection_law.chat_is_disposable: A project must remain recoverable if the originating conversation disappears.
selection_law.unknown_project: If a registered project is not yet bound to exact durable workstreams, resolve by aliases against current runtime/catalog once, then persist the binding instead of asking the human to transport old chat context.
